newsitem.title: UK: Sterling holds above 2.80 marks, $1.63 in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Sterling holds above 2.80 marks, $1.63 in Europe.

text.p: 1324 GMT - Sterling steady just off session lows in afternoon Europe, retaining foothold above 2.80 marks though remaining down on day with dollar. Cable sticks above $1.63.

* Market ignores rise in UK March M4, which in line with forecasts. M4 up a provisional s/a 11.2 pct y/y vs expected 11.0 and Feb's 11.2. Major bank and building society lending up s/a 4.5 bln stg, largest rise since 1991.
* Total UK production of cars up 5.4 percent s/a in six months ended March 1997.

* Sterling at 2.8050/50 marks vs 2.8115/25 in late Europe on Thursday, weighed down by Bundesbank president Tietmeyer's comment Thursday that central bank not interested in seeing further mark weakness.
* Cable off peaks and trading at $1.6324/35 vs $1.6300/10 in late Europe Thursday, buoyed by dollar dip.
